items.value: Placeholder Room
A room that is a placeholder. What else do you need to know about it?
Bus
Baldi now has his OWN bus! Without this, how would you even get to school?
Occupied Bus
Like a regular bus, but Baldi is sitting in it. Hurry up and get in!
Campfire
What would a campsite be without a ROASTY, TOASTY CAMPFIRE?!
Johnny Sign
A sign with Johnny's face on it that slowly spins around. Typically placed in Johnny's Store!
Placed 'Nana Peel
The 'Nana Peel, but placed! Place it anywhere you'd like to create traps or other strange scenarios.
1st Prize (Static)
It's 1st Prize! Aw man, he can't move...

Puts a Plant up against a wall of your choosing automatically!
